meta.name: Higher education and research institutions (IIT/IIM/NIT/IISER/AIIMS/IISc/central universities, ISRO/CSIR/DAE/DRDO labs) with NIRF 2025 Overall rank
meta.source_org: Wikidata (CC0); NIRF, Ministry of Education (rank and score)
meta.license: Wikidata CC0; NIRF public Government of India data
meta.limitations: NIRF 2025 is the latest edition found (2026 page returned 404). Coverage of the categories depends on Wikidata labels and coordinates and is not guaranteed complete: see data/meta/universities.md for counts per category. Only the Overall top 100 have rank and score. DRDO labs only if Wikidata lists them with coordinates. Several DRDO/ISRO items share the HQ coordinate of their parent. Founded year is empty if Wikidata has no inception date.
meta.method: SPARQL pulls from Wikidata (classes: university, research institute, central university, Institute of National Importance, plus name searches). Category from the label (IIT, IIM, NIT, IISER, AIIMS, IISc, IIIT) or the Wikidata class. ISRO/CSIR/DAE/DRDO labs are items with a parent-organisation link to the agency. NIRF names are joined to Wikidata labels by a normalised name (unmatched ones are listed in the meta file). State from point-in-polygon.

source_ids.name: Source ids
source_ids.description: Identifiers in the source datasets (e.g. Wikidata QID)

coord_precision.name: Coordinate precision
coord_precision.description: site = Wikidata point of the institution; locality = point of the place in which it lies
